card: Adds functional test coverage for global PSBT version decoding in rpc_psbt.py. It verifies that PSBTs with unsupported global version numbers are rejected on decode and that omitting the version field triggers fallback parsing as PSBT version 0. The author demonstrates that mutating PSBT version checks in psbt.h previously triggered no test failures.
changed_since_previous: Now includes the diff, confirming these are Python functional tests in rpc_psbt.py rather than C++ unit tests.
evidence: Author diff demonstrations showing that modifying PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION or removing the missing-tx check for version 0 in psbt.h triggered zero existing test failures.
problem: Global PSBT version decoding behavior lacked test coverage. Regressions or unintended changes to PSBT version limits or default version-0 fallback handling would pass test suites undetected.

risk.why: Touches only functional test code for PSBT RPC parsing.

summary: Adds two functional test cases to rpc_psbt.py verifying global PSBT version decoding behavior. One test checks that an unsupported version number in PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION causes decodepsbt to fail, and the other verifies that omitting the version field causes the PSBT to be parsed as version 0.
